You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: grounding_check: article 'generate-and-submit-claims' does not answer the ticket: The article only explains claim generation, submission steps, and troubleshooting specific validation or transmission errors, not how to investigate or resolve a system-wide clearinghouse module failure. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Urgent: Electronic insurance claim submission failure

To whom it may concern, our billing department is currently unable to batch and submit insurance claims due to a system-wide failure affecting the clearinghouse submission module. Kindly investigate this service disruption as a matter of urgency.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the system-wide issue affecting the clearinghouse submission module. I understand how critical timely claim submissions are for your billing operations.

I want to assure you that a member of our support team has been assigned to investigate this disruption. We will look into the root cause and work on a resolution as quickly as possible.

If you have any additional details or logs that might help us diagnose the problem, please feel free to share them.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Support Team]"
}
